repository.status: Model development complete; all code, weights, configurations, and baseline/primary models permanently frozen in development freeze commit

scientific_integrity_statement: Earlier dataset audit used official test data and labels for integrity and descriptive characterization, including attack-event structure. No test-derived information was used for model fitting, feature selection, hyperparameter or window selection, model selection, or threshold calibration.

preprocessing_and_feature_pipeline.scaler_fit_source: train1_features.npy + train2_features.npy (Development Training: 442,802 rows, strictly train-only)

score_definition.metric: RMSE (normalized L2 residual) across the 79 standardized features
score_definition.accumulation_precision: float64 accumulation of squared differences across 79 features

common_evaluation_timeline.common_target_rule: target row index >= 30 within every official test recording
common_evaluation_timeline.baseline_exclusion_rule: First 29 target predictions (indices 1..29) of Persistence and Ridge are excluded from primary cross-model comparison
common_evaluation_timeline.session_independence: Each test recording evaluated strictly independently; no window or prediction across session boundaries

evaluation_rules.alarm_condition: alarm_t = score_t > threshold (score == threshold is classified as normal)
evaluation_rules.alarm_event_definition: maximal contiguous run of alarm_t == True; no smoothing, no hysteresis, no alarm merging, no minimum-duration filter
evaluation_rules.ground_truth_attack_event_definition: maximal contiguous run of attack == 1 within each individual test file; never merge across file boundaries

process_label_event_summary.process_set: List of active process tags during event, e.g. ['P1', 'P3']

steps: 1. Sort ground-truth attack events by start time within each test file
2. Sort predicted alarm events by start time within each test file
3. For each ground-truth attack in chronological order, match earliest currently-unmatched predicted alarm event with non-zero temporal overlap with that attack
4. A predicted event can match at most one ground-truth attack event
5. A ground-truth attack event can match at most one predicted alarm event

outcomes.unmatched_predicted_alarm_event: Event-level False Positive (FP) (may include redundant chatter during an attack interval)

event_level_metrics.event_f1: 2 * precision * recall / (precision + recall) (0.0 if precision + recall == 0.0)

detection_delay.definition: first alarm-positive timestamp inside evaluable attack interval minus effective attack start (seconds)
detection_delay.missed_attacks: NA (null / NaN), strictly not recorded as infinity

normal_false_alarm_metrics.normal_alarm_sequence: normal_alarm_t = alarm_t AND (attack_t == 0) within each test file; attack timestamps break normal runs
normal_false_alarm_metrics.normal_false_alarm_event_definition: maximal contiguous run of normal_alarm_t == True
normal_false_alarm_metrics.demarcation: Reported separately from event-level unmatched alarms; operational false-alarm burden strictly measures normal periods

multiseed_policy.evaluation: Evaluate seeds 42, 43, 44 independently under identical protocol
multiseed_policy.canonical_model: Seed 42 is the canonical primary model for headline timeline figures, demo, and representative attack plots
multiseed_policy.selection_constraint: No post-hoc cherry-picking of best-performing seed on test
